quick_skim.title: EIB-Net: Entropy-Guided Information Bottleneck for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
quick_skim.abstract: The proliferation of photorealistic AI-generated images demands robust detection methods that generalize across diverse generative models. While existing approaches target manipulation-based forgeries with local artifacts, generation-based images (e.g., from diffusion models) lack such traces, posing a fundamental challenge. We observe that generative models prioritize global semantics at the expense of local texture fidelity, making low-texture regions key indicators of synthetic origin. To exploit this, we propose EIB-Net, an Entropy-guided Information Bottleneck Network. EIB-Net introduces a novel Image Entropy (IE) metric to automatically select the most informative (lowest-entropy) patch, then processes it with a Variational Information Bottleneck (VIB) to learn compact, generalizable features. Extensive experiments on DIFF, DiffusionForensics, and GenImage benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance: EIB-Net achieves 85.7\% accuracy using only 2\% of training data, outperforming full-image baselines by over 15\%, and maintains robust cross-generator generalization (83.5\% average accuracy on GenImage). Furthermore, our entropy-guided patch selection (EGPL) consistently enhances diverse backbones (CNNs and Transformers), proving its practical value for data-efficient detection.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: EIB-Net detects AI-generated images by exploiting that diffusion models sacrifice local texture fidelity, selecting low-entropy patches and processing them with an information bottleneck.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 逼真AI生成图像的泛滥要求能跨多种生成模型泛化的检测方法，但生成式图像缺乏篡改类伪造的局部伪影，检测困难。作者观察到生成模型重全局语义而牺牲局部纹理保真度，低纹理区域成为合成来源的关键线索。据此提出EIB-Net，用图像熵指标自动选取信息量最高的低熵图像块，并借助变分信息瓶颈网络进行判别。实验表明该熵引导策略提升了跨模型泛化检测性能，为生成内容真实性认证提供支撑。
